blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Coding agents solve repository-level software engineering tasks through long trajectories of code inspection, search, editing, and testing. As a task progresses, earlier exploration becomes stale, so managing context is more than avoiding overflow: an agent must decide when to compact, what working state to preserve, and how to continue from it. We introduce AutoCompact, which trains a coding agent to make these decisions as part of its policy. To collect training data, we run the base agent on coding tasks and use a judge to review its compaction decisions, summaries, and actions after compaction. Flawed outputs are replaced with corrected ones before being executed in the environment, so each trajectory continues from the corrected decisions. We use these trajectories for supervised fine-tuning, then jointly optimize coding and compaction through reinforcement learning with task-success rewards. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-PolyBench Verified show that AutoCompact improves pass rates over the base model by an absolute 9.2% and 5.0%, respectively. The improvements hold across all evaluated inference budgets, with a 256K context window that never overflows and with a 16K window whose overflow triggers fallback compaction.
blocks.zh: 编码代理通过代码检查,搜索,编辑,测试的长轨来解决存储器级软件工程任务. 随着任务的进展,更早的探索变得僵化了,因此管理环境不仅仅是避免溢出:代理人必须决定何时紧凑,保存什么工作状态,以及如何继续。 我们引进了AutoCompact,它训练一个编码代理商,将作出这些决定作为其政策的一部分。 为了收集培训数据,我们运行了编码任务的基干员,并使用一名法官来审查其压缩后的决定、摘要和行动。 在环境执行前,用被更正的产出取而代之,因此,每个轨迹都从被更正的决定中继续。 我们利用这些轨迹进行有监督的微调,然后通过强化学习和任务成功的奖励,共同优化编码和收缩。 关于SWE-bench验证和SWE-Poly Bench验证的实验显示,AutoCompact将比基模型的通过率分别提高9.2%和5.0%. 改进涉及所有经评价的推论预算,其上下文窗口为256K,永不溢出,并有一个16K个窗口,其溢出会触发回落收缩。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities on repository-level software engineering tasks by inspecting code, searching the repository, editing files, and running tests ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . Resolving complex issues often requires investigating multiple candidate causes and iterating between implementation and validation, so trajectories accumulate code snippets, tool outputs, and intermediate findings. As the agent moves from one stage of a task to the next, much of this information, such as exploratory hypotheses, failed attempts, and detailed tool outputs, becomes stale. Keeping the full trajectory thus fills the context with outdated details, whereas the next stage needs only a compact working state : the conclusions reached so far, the relevant code and workspace status, and the remaining actions. Effective context management therefore requires an agent to decide when to compact, what information to preserve in the working state, and how to continue execution from it.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLM)代理通过检查代码,搜索存储器,编辑文件,以及运行测试,在存储器一级软件工程任务上表现出了强大的能力(Jimenez等,2024;Yang等,2024;Wang等,2025.). 解决复杂的问题往往需要调查多个候选原因,并在执行和验证之间延后,因此轨迹会积累代码片段,工具输出,以及中间结果. 随着代理人从任务的一个阶段转移到下一个阶段,许多这类信息,如探索性假设,失败的尝试,以及详细的工具输出,变得乏味. 因此,保持整个轨道充满了过时的细节,而下一阶段只需要一个紧凑的工作状态:迄今所达成的结论、有关的守则和工作空间状况以及其余的行动。 因此,有效的环境管理要求一个代理人决定何时压缩、在工作状态中保存哪些信息以及如何继续执行。

blocks.en: Existing approaches address only part of this problem. Length-triggered methods such as CompactionRL ( Li et al., 2026b ) compact only when the remaining context budget falls below a fixed threshold, which ties compaction to context length rather than task progress: stale exploration accumulates until the threshold is reached, and compaction may then occur in the middle of an unresolved stage whose evidence is still needed. Proactive methods instead let the agent decide when to compact, either through an inference-time rubric ( Li et al., 2026a ) or through fine-tuning on trajectories into which compression calls are inserted offline ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . However, deciding when to compact is not sufficient: the working state may omit or misrepresent key information, and even when it is correct, the agent may fail to follow it, revisiting completed exploration or ignoring the intended next action. Neither kind of proactive method addresses these failures: a rubric provides no training signal, and offline insertion keeps the original actions after each inserted call.
blocks.zh: 现有办法仅能解决这一问题的一部分。 长度-触发方法,如ConcessionRL (Li等,2026b.) Concession Concession 只有在剩余上下文预算低于固定阈值时,才将收缩与上下文长度挂钩,而不是任务进度挂钩: steal exploration会累积到达到阈值之前,然后在尚未解决的阶段中间会发生收缩,而这个阶段仍然需要证据. 相反,由代理人通过推断时间(Li等,2026年a)或通过对线下插入压缩呼叫的轨迹进行微调(Liu等,2026年)决定何时压缩。 然而,决定何时紧凑是不够的:工作状态可能省略或歪曲关键信息,即使信息正确,代理人也可能没有跟踪信息,重新审视已完成的勘探或者忽略预期的下一步行动. 这两种主动方法都不处理这些故障:一个标题不提供训练信号,离线插入在每次插入呼叫后保留原始动作.

blocks.en: We introduce AutoCompact, which trains a coding agent to decide when to compact, what to preserve, and how to continue as part of its policy. To collect training data, we run the base agent on training tasks and use a judge to review its compaction decisions, the summaries it writes, and its actions after compaction. The judge replaces flawed outputs with corrected ones before they are executed in the environment, so each trajectory continues from the corrected decisions and shows how to act after compaction. We use these trajectories for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and then apply outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL), which jointly optimizes coding and compaction with binary task success as the only reward signal.
blocks.zh: 我们引入AutoCompact,它训练一个编码代理来决定何时紧凑,保存什么,如何继续作为它政策的一部分. 为了收集培训数据,我们管理着培训任务的基础代理人,并使用一名法官来审查它的收缩决定、它所撰写的摘要以及紧凑之后的行动。 法官在环境中执行错误的产出之前用被更正的产出来取而代之,因此每个轨迹都延续于被更正的决定,并显示在收缩后如何行动. 我们使用这些轨迹进行有监督的微调(SFT),然后应用基于结果的强化学习(RL),这些强化学习与二进制任务的成功共同优化了编码和收缩,作为唯一的奖励信号.

blocks.en: We evaluate AutoCompact on SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) and SWE-PolyBench Verified ( Rashid et al., 2025 ) , achieving pass rates of 39.6% and 24.5%, respectively, with improvements of 9.2% and 5.0% over the base model. We further examine cost efficiency on SWE-bench Verified under two complementary context regimes: a 256K setting in which no trajectory reaches the forced-compaction threshold, and a constrained 16K setting in which all methods share the same length-triggered fallback. The trained policies consistently improve performance across all evaluated budgets from $0.10 to $4.00 per task, with outcome-based RL providing further gains over SFT, especially at low budgets. Comparing the same trained checkpoint with and without executing compaction further shows that compaction is particularly beneficial under tight inference budgets, supporting its contribution to efficient task completion.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了SWE-bench验证(Jimenez等人,2024年;OpenAI,2024年)和SWE-Poly Bench验证(Rashid等人,2025年)的自动协议,通过率分别达到39.6%和24.5%,比基准模型提高了9.2%和5.0%。 我们进一步审查了在两个互补背景下验证的SWE-bench的成本效率:一个是256K设定,其中没有轨迹达到强制协作阈值;另一个是受限的16K设定,在该设定中,所有方法都具有相同的长度触发回落。 训练有素的政策持续改善所有经评价预算的绩效,从每项任务的0.10美元提高到4.00美元,基于成果的RL比SFT有进一步的收益,特别是在低预算中。 将同一训练有素的检查站与不执行紧凑措施作一比较,进一步表明紧凑措施在紧张的推断预算下特别有益,有助于有效完成任务。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Length-triggered compaction versus AutoCompact. Under length-triggered compaction, the agent keeps accumulating context after the bug is localized, such as repeated searches with long outputs, and summarizes only when the context limit is reached. AutoCompact lets the model decide (1) when to compact, (2) what to keep, rewriting useful findings into a working-state summary while dropping stale exploration, and (3) how to continue from it.
blocks.zh: 图1:长度-触发收缩对自动压缩。 在长度触发收缩下,代理在bug本地化后不断积累上下文,例如重复搜索并输出长,并仅在达到上下文限制时才进行总结. AutoCompact让模型决定(1)何时紧凑,(2)保存什么,在放弃 stale 探索的同时将有用的发现重写成工作状态摘要,(3)如何继续从中进行.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows. (1) We introduce AutoCompact, which corrects compaction decisions, summaries, and subsequent actions during data collection and executes the corrected outputs in place of the original ones. (2) We collect 1,052 judge-corrected trajectories on SWE-rebench ( Badertdinov et al., 2025 ) to initialize the policy via SFT, followed by outcome-based RL that jointly optimizes coding and compaction without compaction-specific reward shaping. (3) We demonstrate improved task success on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-PolyBench Verified, with gains across inference budgets and context settings. To rule out that these gains stem from training alone, we ignore the compaction calls of the same trained model; the resulting drop in pass rates confirms that executing compaction itself contributes.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下。 (1) 我们采用AutoCompact,它纠正了数据收集过程中的压缩决定、摘要和随后的行动,并执行经更正的产出取而代之。 (2)我们在SWE-rebench(Baderdinov等,2025年)上收集了1 052个法官修正的轨迹,通过SFT初始化政策,然后是基于结果的RL,共同优化编码和收缩,而不会形成特定收缩的奖励. (3) 我们在SWE-bench验证和SWE-Poly Bench验证方面表现出更好的任务成功,在推论预算和背景背景方面都取得了进展。 排除这些收益仅出自培训,我们忽略了同一训练有素模式的收缩要求;由此导致的通过率的下降证实了执行收缩本身的作用。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: AutoCompact equips a coding agent with a compact() action (Section 2.1 ) and trains the policy in two stages. We first collect on-policy trajectories with judge-guided corrections to compaction timing, the generated working state, and the actions immediately following compaction (Section 2.2 ). These corrected trajectories provide the training data for SFT. We then apply outcome-based RL to jointly optimize coding and compaction using final task success as the reward (Section 2.3 ).
blocks.zh: AutoCompact为编码代理人配备了紧凑()动作(第2.1节)并分两个阶段对政策进行培训. 我们首先收集政策轨迹,并附上法官指导的对收缩时间、产生的工作状态和紧凑之后立即采取的行动的更正(第2.2节)。 这些校正的轨迹为SFT提供了培训数据. 然后,我们采用基于结果的RL,利用最后任务的成功作为奖励,共同优化编码和收缩(第2.3节)。

blocks.en: 2.1 Proactive Context Compaction
blocks.zh: 2.1 主动环境紧凑

blocks.en: Figure 2: Judge-guided on-policy data collection. At each step, the judge reviews the policy’s proposal using only the current execution history. Useful exploration is kept, while corrections target (1) when to compact, e.g., replacing a search after the bug is localized with compact() ; (2) what to keep, e.g., repairing a summary that omits the target file; and (3) how to continue, e.g., redirecting a repeated search toward the edit planned in the summary. The environment executes the corrected outputs, and the resulting trajectories supervise SFT; the trained agent needs no judge.
blocks.zh: 图2:法官指导的政策数据收集。 法官每一步都只使用目前的执行历史审查政策提案。 保留了有用的探索,而校正目标 (1)何时紧凑,例如,在错误本地化后用紧凑()来取代搜索; (2) 保存什么,例如,修复一个忽略目标文件的摘要; (3) 如何继续,例如,将重复搜索重定向到摘要中计划的编辑. 环境执行纠正的产出,由此产生的轨迹监督SFT;受过训练的代理人不需要法官。

blocks.en: We augment the agent with a compact() action that can be invoked proactively during execution. The agent otherwise operates normally by inspecting files, editing code, and running tests. When it determines that the current stage has been sufficiently resolved and the accumulated history can be summarized, it may invoke compact() before reaching the context limit. For example, the agent may compact after localizing the cause of an issue and before proceeding to implementation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过在执行过程中可以主动援引的契约行动来充实这一代理人。 代理人通常通过检查文件、编辑代码和运行测试来运作。 当它确定目前阶段已经得到充分解决,并且可以总结所积累的历史时,它可以在达到上下文限制之前援引契约(). 例如,代理人在查明问题的原因后,在着手执行之前,可以压缩。

blocks.en: Compaction replaces earlier interaction history with a model-generated working-state summary headed by # Auto Context Summary , while retaining the original task unchanged. The summary is intended to preserve established findings, relevant code and workspace state, and remaining actions, while omitting unnecessary details of prior exploration. The agent then resumes execution from the resulting context, as illustrated in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 收缩用以#Auto Context Summary为首的模型生成的工作状态摘要来取代更早的交互历史,同时保留原有的任务不变. 该摘要旨在保留既定调查结果、相关守则和工作空间状态以及所余行动,同时省略先前勘探的不必要的细节。 如图1所示,代理人然后从由此产生的背景恢复执行。

blocks.en: This mechanism makes compaction a model decision rather than solely a response to context-window pressure. Its effectiveness therefore depends on three behaviors: choosing an appropriate compaction point, constructing an accurate working state, and continuing reliably from that state. We next describe how we supervise these behaviors through judge-guided on-policy data collection.
blocks.zh: 这种机制使收缩成为一种示范决定,而不仅仅是对上下文窗口压力的反应。 因此,其有效性取决于三种行为:选择适当的收缩点,构建精确的工作状态,以及从该状态可靠地继续. 我们接下来介绍我们如何通过法官指导的政策数据收集监督这些行为。

blocks.en: 2.2 Judge-Guided Data Collection and SFT
blocks.zh: 2.2 法官指导数据收集和SFT

blocks.en: Prompting alone does not induce proactive compaction. In our preliminary experiments, the base model rarely invoked compact() before the context limit, even when compaction rules were specified in the agent prompt. Proactive compaction introduces a behavior that is uncommon in the base policy: the model must interrupt an otherwise valid execution trajectory and replace its accumulated context before any context-limit constraint forces it to do so. We therefore collect training trajectories with online judge corrections and use them for SFT. These corrections provide demonstrations of compaction and subsequent execution that the base policy rarely produces on its own. The judge is used only during data collection; the trained agent runs without the judge at inference time.
blocks.zh: 单靠催促并不能导致主动的收缩。 在我们的初步实验中,基模型很少在上下文限制之前引用收缩(),即使当收缩规则在代理即时被指定. 主动收缩引入了基础政策中罕见的行为:模型必须中断原本有效的执行轨迹,并替换其累积上下文后才能迫使其这样做. 因此,我们收集在线法官惩戒的培训轨迹,并将其用于SFT。 这些更正显示了基础政策很少单独产生的收缩和随后的执行。 法官只在收集数据时使用;经过训练的代理人在推论时没有法官在场。

blocks.en: To collect such demonstrations, we roll out the base policy on software engineering tasks and use a judge to review each proposed action as execution proceeds. The judge receives only the trajectory history available at the current step and determines whether the proposed action is satisfactory, following a predefined annotation protocol that specifies appropriate compaction points, the information that should be preserved in the compacted working state, and how post-compaction behavior should continue. Figure 2 provides an overview of this online corrective data-collection process, with one concrete example of each of the three types of correction described in the next paragraph.
blocks.zh: 为了收集这类演示,我们推出了软件工程任务的基础政策,并使用一名法官审查每项拟议行动,作为执行工作的进展。 法官只接收当前步骤时可用的轨迹历史,并遵循预先确定的注释协议,规定适当的收缩点,在紧凑的工作状态中应当保存的信息,以及合作后的行为应该如何继续,从而确定拟议行动是否令人满意. 图2概述了这一在线纠正数据收集过程,并举例说明了下段所述的三种更正中的每一种。

blocks.en: We supervise three types of decisions corresponding to the main failure modes of compaction. Trigger correction checks whether the current point is appropriate for compaction: the agent should compact when the current stage has been sufficiently resolved, but continue exploring when intermediate evidence is still needed. Working-state correction checks whether the generated # Auto Context Summary accurately preserves the information needed for subsequent execution, including relevant conclusions, code and workspace state, and remaining actions. Continuation correction checks whether the first actions after compaction follow the resulting working state, rather than revisiting completed exploration or ignoring the intended next step, such as re-running a search whose result is already recorded in the working-state summary.
blocks.zh: 我们监督三种类型的决定,它们与主要失败的收缩方式相对应。 触发校正检查当前点是否适合收缩:当当前阶段已充分解决时,代理方应当收紧,但继续探索何时仍然需要中间证据. 工作状态校正检查生成的# Auto Control 概要是否准确保存了后续执行所需的信息,包括相关结论,代码和工作空间状态,以及剩余动作. 继续检查压缩后的第一批行动是否遵循了由此产生的工作状态,而不是重新审视已完成的勘探,或者忽略预期的下一步,例如重新运行搜索,其结果已经记录在工作状态摘要中.

blocks.en: Corrections are applied before execution, so each one shapes the rest of the trajectory. When the judge identifies an output unsatisfactory, it writes a corrected output, which the environment executes in place of the original; the policy then generates the following actions from this corrected history. This differs from post-hoc annotation, where corrections do not influence later states.
blocks.zh: 在行刑前实施惩罚,因此每个惩罚都塑造出其余的轨迹. 当法官确定一个产出不合格时,它会写一个更正后的产出,由环境执行,取而代之的是原产出;然后政策从这个更正后的历史产生以下行动. 这与事后注释不同,其中更正不影响以后的州.

blocks.en: Finally, we fine-tune the base policy on the corrected trajectories with the standard next-token prediction objective. The resulting policy, AutoCompact-SFT, learns both ordinary coding behavior and the three compaction behaviors introduced above: selecting appropriate compaction points, constructing actionable working states, and reliably continuing execution afterward. SFT provides a behavioral initialization for proactive compaction, but it optimizes the locally corrected decisions rather than their eventual effect on task completion. We then further optimize the policy using outcome-based RL, which directly targets task success.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们用标准的下接预测目标,对校正轨迹的基础政策进行微调. 由此而来的政策"AutoCompact-SFT"既学习了普通的编码行为,也学习了上述三个收缩行为:选择适当的收缩点,构建可操作的工作状态,以及可靠地继续执行之后. SFT为主动的收缩提供了行为初始化,但它优化了当地更正的决定,而不是最终对任务完成的影响. 然后,我们利用基于成果的RL进一步优化政策,直接针对任务的成功。

blocks.en: 2.3 Joint RL for Task Solving and Compaction
blocks.zh: 2.3 任务解决和压缩联合RL

blocks.en: Starting from the SFT checkpoint, we further train the agent on SWE-Gym ( Pan et al., 2025 ) with end-to-end multi-turn RL ( Xue et al., 2026 ) , using group relative policy optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) and a fully asynchronous RL system. Each rollout receives a binary outcome reward based on whether the final patch passes the task tests. Within each rollout group, GRPO converts these outcomes into relative advantages, which provide a shared learning signal for all model-generated tokens in a trajectory, including regular coding actions, the decision to invoke compact() , the generated context summary, and the continuation after compaction.
blocks.zh: 从SFT检查站开始,我们进一步在SWE-Gym(Pan等,2025年)上用端到端多转速RL(Xue等,2026年)对代理进行训练,使用分组相对政策优化(GPRO)(Shao等,2024年),并完全同步RL系统. 每次推出都根据最终补丁是否通过任务测试获得二进制结果奖励. 在每一个推出组中,GRPO将这些结果转换为相对优势,这为轨迹中所有模型生成的符号提供共享的学习信号,包括常规编码动作,引用紧凑()的决定,生成的上下文摘要,以及收缩后的持续.

blocks.en: Compaction therefore requires neither a separate auxiliary objective nor compaction-specific reward shaping. Instead, task solving and context management are trained jointly under the final task reward, allowing the policy to learn when compaction is beneficial, what information should be preserved, and how execution should continue afterward.
blocks.zh: 因此,收缩既不需要单独的辅助目标,也不需要特定收缩的奖励。 相反,任务解决和背景管理是在最后任务奖励下联合培训的,使政策能够了解何时压缩是有好处的,应当保存哪些信息,以及随后如何继续执行。

blocks.en: Compaction also changes how trajectories are converted into training sequences, because each call to compact() rewrites the context. As a result, a trajectory with compaction no longer forms a single sequence in which each model turn extends the previous context. We therefore split each trajectory into segments wherever the context prefix is rewritten, such that within each segment every model turn is conditioned on a prefix that only grows. All segments of a trajectory share its advantage, so the decision to compact, the summary, and the actions after compaction receive the same outcome-based signal even though they fall into different segments. The policy loss is averaged at the token level over all segments in a batch, without a KL penalty or an entropy bonus, so the binary outcome reward is the only training signal for both coding and compaction.
blocks.zh: 收缩还改变了轨迹被转换成训练序列的方式,因为每次调用收缩()都会重写上下文. 因此,有收缩的轨迹不再形成一个单一的序列,每个模型在其中转动会延长以前的上下文. 因此,在上下文前缀被重写的地方,我们把每个轨迹分成几个段,这样每个段内,每个模型转弯都以一个只生长的前缀为条件. 轨迹的所有部分都具有其优势,因此,紧凑的决定、摘要和紧凑后的行动都得到同样的基于结果的信号,尽管它们属于不同的部分。 政策损失在批次所有部分的符号级上平均,没有KL罚分或等效奖金,因此二进制结果奖励是编码和收缩的唯一训练信号.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en: Our experiments address three questions. First, does AutoCompact improve task success over full-history execution and over existing length-triggered and proactive compaction methods (Section 3.2 )? Second, how do proactive compaction, outcome-based RL, and the execution of compaction itself contribute across inference budgets and context settings (Section 3.3 )? Third, how do the summaries produced after SFT and after RL differ (Section 3.4 )?
blocks.zh: 我们的实验涉及三个问题。 首先,AutoCompact是否比全史的执行和现有的长发和主动的收缩方法(第3.2节)改善了任务的成功? 第二,积极主动的收缩、基于结果的RL和执行收缩本身如何在推论预算和背景背景中作出贡献(第3.3节)? 第三,在SFT和RL之后编写的摘要有何不同(第3.4节)?

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Models and scaffold. We use Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2025a ) as the base model throughout our experiments and evaluate all model variants on two repository-level software-engineering benchmarks: SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) and SWE-PolyBench Verified ( Rashid et al., 2025 ) . All variants use the same terminal-based read-eval-print loop (REPL) scaffold ( Lin and Liu, 2025 ; Du et al., 2025 ) , augmented with the model-invocable compact() action described in Section 2.1 . During supervised data collection, we additionally use GPT-5.5-Codex as the judge for online correction; the judge is removed during evaluation.
blocks.zh: 模型与脚手架. 我们在整个试验过程中将Qune3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instructionct(Yang等,2025a)作为基准模型,并根据两个存储器级软件工程基准评价所有模型变体: SWE-bench 核查(Jimenez等,2024;OpenAI,2024;SWE-Poly Bench 核查(Rashid等,2025)。 所有变体都使用同一种基于终端的读取-eval-print回路(REPL)脚手架(Lin and Liu, 2025; Du等, 2025),与第2.1节所描述的可被引用的模型()动作相加. 在监督数据收集期间,我们还使用GPT-5.5-Codex作为在线更正的法官;在评估期间,法官被撤职。

blocks.en: Training. For SFT, we roll out the base model on 379 SWE-rebench tasks ( Badertdinov et al., 2025 ) and collect 1,052 judge-corrected trajectories using the procedure in Section 2.2 , after filtering out malformed requests, summary loops, and off-track continuations. Of these trajectories, 24% supervise compaction triggers, 53% supervise working-state construction, and 23% supervise post-compaction continuation. We train for two epochs with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 7 5\times 10^{-7} and a batch size of 8. Starting from AutoCompact-SFT, we further optimize the policy with GRPO on SWE-Gym ( Pan et al., 2025 ) . For each task, we sample 8 trajectories and assign a binary outcome reward according to whether the final patch passes the task-specific test suite. RL uses a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} and a batch size of 64, with rollouts capped at 50 environment steps and 32K tokens.
blocks.zh: 培训。 对于SFT,我们推出379个SWE-rebench任务的基础模型(Baderdinov等,2025年),并在过滤出错误的请求后,利用2.2节中的程序收集了1,052个法官修正的轨迹,简要循环,以及脱轨续作. 在这些轨迹中,24%是监督收缩触发器,53%是监督工作状态的建设,23%是监督合作后的延续。 我们为两个时代训练,学习率为5×10−7 5\Times 10×7],分批规模为8个. 从Auto Compact-SFT开始,我们在SWE-Gym上与GPRO进一步优化政策(Pan等,2025年). 对于每项任务,我们抽取了8个轨迹,并根据最终补丁是否通过任务特定测试套件来分配二进制结果奖励. RL使用1×10−6 1\times 10×6}的学习速率,批量规模为64个,以50个环境步骤和32K个令牌为起步.

blocks.en: Evaluation. We report pass rates on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-PolyBench Verified using full agent runs without an inference-cost cap. All reported quantitative evaluation results are averaged over three runs. To assess cost efficiency, we additionally evaluate SWE-bench Verified under six per-task inference budgets from $0.10 to $4.00 (Figure 3 ). Each rollout is terminated when its cumulative inference cost reaches the specified budget. We estimate inference costs from token usage using the official Alibaba Cloud Model Studio pricing for Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct ( Alibaba Cloud, 2026 ) . To account for prefix caching, we price cached tokens at 20% of the standard input-token rate, following Alibaba Cloud Model Studio’s implicit-caching pricing, and price uncached input and output tokens at their respective standard rates.
blocks.zh: 评价。 我们报告SWE-bench验证和SWE-Poly Bench验证的通过率,使用全代理运行,没有推断成本上限。 所有报告的定量评价结果平均分三轮进行。 为了评估成本效率,我们进一步评价了在6个任务推算预算下核实的SWE-bench,从0.10美元到4.00美元(图3)。 每次推算费用累计达到规定预算时,终止推算. 我们使用官方的Alibaba Cloud Model Studio定价, 对Qune3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct(Alibaba Cloud, 2026)进行信使使用的推算费用估算。 以阿里巴巴云模型工作室的隐含刻录定价,以及按各自标准费率定价未刻录的输入和输出符号。

blocks.en: Table 1: Full-run pass rates without an inference-cost cap, grouped by compaction trigger. All methods share the same base model and scaffold. In the Context column, 256K denotes the model context window, while † \dagger marks a 16K forced-compaction threshold.
blocks.zh: 表1:不设推算成本上限的全程通过率,按收缩触发器分类。 所有方法都共享相同的基模型和脚手架. 在上下文一栏中,256K表示模型上下文窗口,而\\dagger则标记了16K的强制比较阈值.

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare AutoCompact against several context-management strategies. Base uses the same underlying model and scaffold without learned proactive compaction. Fixed Compaction triggers compaction when the remaining context budget falls below a predefined threshold. SelfCompact ( Li et al., 2026a ) uses an inference-time rubric to guide compaction decisions, while CompactionRL ( Li et al., 2026b ) jointly trains task execution and summary generation under a length-triggered compaction mechanism. SWE-Compressor ( Liu et al., 2026 ) learns to invoke a context-management tool through supervised fine-tuning on trajectories reconstructed offline by inserting compression calls. For this SFT comparison, we collect trajectories from comparable SWE-rebench task sets and use similar numbers of training trajectories for SWE-Compressor and AutoCompact-SFT. Unlike these baselines, AutoCompact corrects the agent’s compaction decisions and subsequent actions during data collection, directly supervising how the agent uses the compacted state.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较Auto Compact 和一些上下文管理战略。 基地使用相同的基础模型和脚手架,没有学会的主动收缩. 当剩余的上下文预算低于预先确定的门槛值时,固定压缩会触发收缩. SelfCompact (Li等, 2026a.) 使用推论-时标来指导收缩决定,而CompactionRL (Li等, 2026b.) 在长起收缩机制下联合训练任务执行和摘要生成. SWE 压缩器 (Liu等,2026年)通过插入压缩调用,通过对线下重建的轨迹进行有监督的微调来学习引用上下文管理工具. 为了进行这种SFT比较,我们从可比的SWE-rebench任务集中收集出轨迹,并使用类似的SWE-Compressor和AutoCompact-SFT的训练轨迹. 与这些基线不同,AutoCompact纠正了代理在数据收集过程中的收缩决定和随后的行动,直接监督代理如何使用收缩状态.

blocks.en: 3.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Figure 3: Pass rate versus inference budget on SWE-bench Verified. (a) AutoCompact-SFT versus Base at 256K, where no trajectory reaches the forced-compaction threshold. (b) AutoCompact (after RL) versus AutoCompact-SFT at 256K. (c) AutoCompact versus Base at 16K, with a shared forced-compaction fallback. (d) The same checkpoint following versus ignoring summaries. Budget categories are equally spaced; gains denote additional solved tasks per 500 tasks.
blocks.zh: 图3:通过率与SWE基准的推论预算对比 (a) 自动订约-SFT对 基座为256K,其中没有轨迹达到强制协同阈值. (b) 自动订约(在RL之后)对自动订约-SFT为256K。 (c) 自动订约与 基地位于16K,拥有共享的强制协同后退. (d) 在摘要之后设置同一检查站。 预算类别间距相等;收益表示每500个任务中额外解决的任务.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , AutoCompact achieves the highest full-run pass rates on both benchmarks, improving over Base by 9.2% on SWE-bench Verified and 5.0% on SWE-PolyBench Verified.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,AutoCompact在两个基准上实现了最高的全程通过率,在SWE-bench验证中比Base提高了9.2%,在SWE-Poly Bench验证中提高了5.0%。

blocks.en: Length-triggered compaction yields limited gains. Fixed Compaction underperforms Base by 1.6% and 0.9% on the two benchmarks, indicating a performance cost in this constrained-context setting. CompactionRL improves upon Fixed Compaction by 3.9% and 1.2% through RL. However, its gains over Base remain limited, leaving a substantial gap to AutoCompact.
blocks.zh: 长时间触发的收缩产生的收益有限。 固定收缩不足 依据两个基准计算1.6%和0.9%,表明在这种受限制的语境背景下的绩效成本。 收缩RL在固定收缩后通过RL提高3.9%和1.2%. 然而,它对基地的收益仍然有限,给Auto Compact留下了很大的缺口。

blocks.en: Proactive compaction outperforms full-history execution. Under the 256K setting, all evaluated proactive methods, including SelfCompact, SWE-Compressor, and the AutoCompact variants, outperform Base on both benchmarks. SelfCompact achieves improvements through inference-time guidance alone, while SWE-Compressor learns compaction-tool use through SFT. These results suggest that proactive context management helps even when the full history fits in context.
blocks.zh: 主动的收缩超越了全部历史处决. 在256K设定下,所有被评价的主动方法,包括SelfCompact,SWE-Compressor,以及自动Compact变体,均在两个基准上都超过业绩. SelfCompact仅通过推论时间指导实现改进,而SWE-Compresser则通过SFT学习收缩工具的使用. 这些结果表明,即使整个历史符合具体情况,主动的环境管理也会有所帮助。

blocks.en: Online judge-guided SFT and outcome-based RL both add gains. AutoCompact-SFT exceeds SWE-Compressor by 1.2% and 1.6% on the two benchmarks. Since both use the same base model, scaffold, and comparable training data, this comparison suggests that online judge-guided correction is more effective than offline insertion into completed trajectories. AutoCompact-SFT learns from trajectories in which the corrected outputs, including corrected actions after compaction, were actually executed, whereas SWE-Compressor inserts compaction calls into completed trajectories and keeps their original subsequent actions. Outcome-based RL then improves pass rates by a further 7.4% and 2.8% over AutoCompact-SFT on the two benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 在线法官指导的SFT和基于结果的RL都增加了收益. AutoCompact-SFT在两个基准上超过SWE-Compressor1.2%和1.6%. 由于两者都使用相同的基模型"脚手架"和可比较的训练数据,这种比较表明在线法官制导的校正比离线插入完成的轨迹更有效. AutoCompact-SFT学习了经过校正的输出,包括收缩后经过校正的动作实际被执行的轨迹,而SWE-Compressor则将收缩调用插入到已完成的轨迹中,并保持其最初的后继动作. 然后,基于结果的RL在两个基准上比AutoCompact-SFT进一步提高了7.4%和2.8%的通过率。

blocks.en: 3.3 Further Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 进一步分析

blocks.en: Proactive compaction helps before context overflow. We first compare Base with AutoCompact-SFT under the 256K long-context setting. Because no trajectory reaches the forced-compaction threshold, this comparison tests whether supervised training for proactive compaction improves agent performance even when the full interaction history fits within the context window. As shown in Figure 3 (a), AutoCompact-SFT achieves a higher pass rate than Base across all evaluated inference budgets. This result shows that retaining the complete interaction history is not necessarily optimal, even when the context window is sufficiently large. Over long trajectories, obsolete hypotheses, failed attempts, and verbose tool outputs can accumulate and distract the model from the current working state. By replacing stale history with a concise working state, AutoCompact-SFT improves performance before context becomes a bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 主动的收缩有助于在上下文溢出之前。 我们首先在256K长文本设置下 比较Base和AutoCompact-SFT. 由于没有轨迹达到强制比对阈值,这种比较检验了主动收缩的有监督的培训是否提高代理性能,即使完全的相互作用历史符合上下文窗口。 如图3(a)所示,AutoCompact-SFT在所有经评价的推论预算中的通过率高于Base。 这一结果表明,保留完整的交互历史并不一定是最佳的,即使上下文窗口足够大. 过长的轨迹,过时的假说,失败的尝试,和动词工具输出可以积累并分散模型对当前工作状态的注意力. AutoCompact-SFT通过用简洁的工作状态来取而代之来取而代之来,在上下文成为瓶颈之前提高了性能.

blocks.en: Outcome-based RL improves beyond supervised imitation. Under the same 256K protocol, we compare AutoCompact-SFT with AutoCompact. As shown in Figure 3 (b), AutoCompact consistently outperforms AutoCompact-SFT across all inference budgets, with the largest gains in the low-budget regime. These results suggest that SFT establishes the basic compaction behavior, while outcome-based RL further improves how this behavior is used to maximize task success. Since low budgets cut rollouts short, the larger gains at these budgets indicate that RL makes the agent more cost-efficient rather than simply relying on longer trajectories.
blocks.zh: 基于成果的RL改进超出了监督模仿的范围. 根据同样的256K协议,我们比较AutoCompact-SFT和AutoCompact. 如图3(b)所示,AutoCompact在所有推论预算中一贯优于AutoCompact-SFT,在低预算制度中收益最大。 这些结果表明,SFT建立了基本的收缩行为,而基于结果的RL则进一步改善了如何利用这种行为来最大限度地实现任务成功. 由于低预算的推出时间短,这些预算的较大收益表明,RL使该剂更具成本效益,而不是仅仅依靠较长的轨迹。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Compaction behavior, with (1), (2), and (3) marking when to compact, what to keep, and how to continue (Figure 1 ). (a) Fraction of tasks in which the model proactively invokes compact() . (b) Fraction of summaries that omit relevant task or workspace state. (c) Fraction of summaries that omit a concrete next action. Lower is better in (b) and (c).
blocks.zh: 图4 收缩行为,有(1),(2),和(3) 标记何时收紧,保存什么,如何继续(图一. (a) 模型主动援引契约的任务分数。 (b) 略去相关任务或工作空间状态的摘要分数。 (c) 未采取具体下一步行动的摘要。 在(b)和(c)中,下调较好。

blocks.en: RL improves compaction behavior without compaction-specific rewards. Figure 4 compares compaction behavior before and after RL. While Base rarely invokes compact() , AutoCompact-SFT already uses it on 44.3% of tasks, indicating that supervised training establishes the basic behavior. RL extends its use to 58.5% of tasks while reducing both types of summary omission: key-state omissions fall from 3.1% to 0.2%, and next-action omissions fall from 8.2% to 2.2%. These statistics are computed on trajectories for all 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks using keyword-based screening, supplemented by random manual spot checks. The two trends are complementary: compaction is used across more tasks, yet fewer summaries are flagged for missing state or next-action information. This suggests that task-success rewards encourage the agent to preserve information needed to continue the task from the compacted state.
blocks.zh: RL改进了收缩行为而无需收缩特定奖励. 图4比较了RL前后的收缩行为. Base虽然很少引用contact(),但AutoCompact-SFT已经在44.3%的任务中使用了它,表明受监督的培训确立了基本行为. RL将其使用范围扩大到了58.5%的任务,同时将两种类型的即时遗漏都减少了:密钥状态遗漏从3.1%下降到0.2%,而后行遗漏从8.2%下降到2.2%。 这些统计数据是用基于关键词的筛选方法对所有500个SWE-bench验证任务进行轨迹计算,并辅之以随机人工抽查。 这两种趋势是相辅相成的:在更多的任务中使用了收缩法,但对缺失的状态或下一个行动信息所标出的摘要却较少. 这表明,任务成功的奖励鼓励代理人保存从紧凑国家继续任务所需的信息。

blocks.en: Proactive compaction complements a length-triggered fallback. We evaluate Base and AutoCompact under a shared 16K forced-compaction threshold. This setting represents a context-constrained runtime in which both systems use forced compaction as a fallback, while AutoCompact can also invoke compact() proactively before reaching the threshold. As shown in Figure 3 (c), AutoCompact achieves a higher pass rate than Base across all evaluated inference budgets. This result shows that learned proactive context management remains effective when deployed together with a length-triggered fallback, allowing the agent to reorganize its context before compaction becomes mandatory. It also indicates that compaction based on task progress is more effective than compaction based solely on the length of the context.
blocks.zh: 主动的收缩补充了长发回落. 我们评价Base和AutoCompact 在一个共享的 16K 强制协作阈值。 这种设置代表了一种上下文受限制的运行时间,两种系统都使用强制收缩作为倒置,而AutoCompact也可以在达到阈值前主动引用收缩(). 如图3(c)所示,AutoCompany在所有经评价的推论预算中的通过率高于Base。 这一结果表明,经验丰富的主动环境管理,如果与长时间触发的倒计时一起部署,仍然有效,使代理人能够在硬化成为强制性之前重组其环境。 它还表明,基于任务进度的收缩比仅基于上下文长度的收缩更有效.

blocks.en: Compaction contributes to the gains of the trained agent. The gains of AutoCompact may reflect both better agent behavior learned during training and the use of compaction during inference. To assess the latter contribution, we compare normal execution with a Summary-ignored variant of the same trained checkpoint. In this variant, compact() calls are skipped: no summary is generated, and execution continues with the existing history. Both conditions retain all learned parameters, allowing us to test whether executing compaction provides a benefit beyond the improvements encoded in those parameters. Figure 3 (d) shows that normal execution achieves higher pass rates, with the largest advantage under tight inference budgets. This indicates that the observed gains cannot be attributed solely to better agent behavior learned during training: part of the benefit depends on actually executing compaction. The advantage is 19.9% at $0.10 and remains 1.9% at $4.00, so executing compaction improves cost efficiency without reducing final performance.
blocks.zh: 收缩有助于训练有素的代理人的收益。 AutoCompact的收益可能既反映训练期间学到的更好的代理行为,也反映推论期间使用收缩. 为了评估后一种贡献,我们将正常执行与同一训练有素检查站的简易变体进行比较。 在这个变式中,收缩调 () 调用被跳过: 没有生成摘要, 而执行会继续沿用现有的历史 。 这两个条件都保留了所有学到的参数,使我们能够检验执行收缩是否在这些参数所编码的改进之外提供了好处。 图3(d)显示,正常执行的通过率较高,在严格的推论预算下具有最大的优势。 这表明,所观察到的收益不能仅仅归因于在培训期间学到的更好的代理行为:部分收益取决于实际执行收缩。 优点是19.9%为0.10美元,1.9%为4.00美元,因此,执行压缩可以提高成本效益而不会降低最终业绩。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Summary self-consistency on SWE-bench Verified task django-13809 . This qualitative example contrasts paraphrased summaries from AutoCompact-SFT and AutoCompact with their final evaluation outcomes. Each summary records a state and proposes a next action; the marker between them indicates whether the action is consistent with the recorded state.
blocks.zh: 图5:关于SWE-bench的自我一致性摘要 这一定性例子与AutoCompact-SFT和AutoCompact的被译出的摘要与其最终的评价结果形成对比。 每个摘要记录一个状态,并提出下一个行动;它们之间的标记表明该行动是否符合记录状态。

blocks.en: 3.4 Case Study: Summary Self-Consistency under SFT and RL
blocks.zh: 3.4 案例研究:在SFT和RL下的简要自足性

blocks.en: Preserving the relevant state and specifying a next action do not by themselves make a summary usable. The summary-content metrics in Figure 4 check both, yet a summary can satisfy them while proposing a next action incompatible with the state it records, violating what we call summary self-consistency . Figure 5 illustrates this gap through paraphrased summaries from AutoCompact-SFT and AutoCompact on the same SWE-bench Verified task.
blocks.zh: 保留有关国家并具体说明下一步行动本身并不能使摘要发挥作用。 图4中的总结内容衡量标准检查了两者,然而总结可以满足它们,同时提出与它记录的状态不相容的下一个行动,违反了我们所称的总结自我一致性。 图5通过AutoCompact-SFT和AutoCompact在同一SWE-bench验证任务上的简化摘要来说明这一差距。

blocks.en: The two summaries in Figure 5 differ in exactly this respect. The AutoCompact-SFT summary records an unresolved syntax error but still proposes finishing without further action: the error is retained in the summary, yet it fails to constrain the proposed continuation. In contrast, the AutoCompact summary reports that the parameter and conditional-logic changes are complete and proposes verification before submission. This next step is consistent with the recorded implementation state. The corresponding AutoCompact-SFT run fails at evaluation with a SyntaxError , while the AutoCompact run passes the tests and resolves the task.
blocks.zh: 图5中的两个摘要在这方面完全不同。 AutoCompact-SFT摘要记录了一个未解决的语法错误,但仍提议在不采取进一步行动的情况下完成:该错误被保留在摘要中,但未能限制拟议的延续。 相比之下,AutoCompact摘要报告说,参数和有条件的逻辑变化是完整的,并在提交之前提出核查建议. 下一步与记录的执行状态一致。 相应的 AutoCompact-SFT 运行在使用语法Error 进行评价时失败,而 AutoCompact 运行则通过测试并解决了任务.

blocks.en: This contrast highlights summary self-consistency as a dimension of summary quality beyond information coverage. The difference may stem from the training objectives: SFT imitates demonstrated summaries, which does not ensure that the recorded state constrains the next action, whereas RL rewards a summary only through the success of the actions that follow it.
blocks.zh: 这一对比凸显出简要的自相容性是信息覆盖面以外的摘要质量的一个层面。 区别可能出自培训目标:SFT模仿了所展示的总结,这并不能确保所记录的状态会约束下一场行动,而RL只能通过后续行动的成功来奖励总结.

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: Coding agents. Research on repository-level coding improves task-solving capabilities through both harness design and model training. Work on harness design organizes repository exploration, code editing, and validation through agent-computer interfaces, tool execution environments, and structured repair workflows ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2025 ) . Work on model training improves coding and problem-solving capabilities through executable task environments, expanded task and trajectory datasets, and supervised or reinforcement learning ( Pan et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Wei et al., 2025 ) . AutoCompact combines the two as model-harness co-design: the harness exposes a compact() action, and the model learns to use it jointly with task execution rather than through a separate compression module.
blocks.zh: 编码代理商. 关于储存库编码的研究通过利用设计和模型培训提高了任务解决能力。 牵引设计工作通过代理-计算机接口,工具执行环境,以及结构化维修工作流程,组织仓库探索,代码编辑,验证(杨等,2024;王等,2025;夏等,2025. 关于示范培训的工作通过可执行的任务环境、扩大任务和轨迹数据集以及监督或强化学习,提高了编码和解决问题的能力(Pan等,2025;Yang等,2025b;Wei等,2025)。 AutoCompact将两者结合为模型-harness co-design:被牵引会暴露出一个紧凑()动作,而模型学习将其与任务执行一起使用,而不是通过单独的压缩模块.

blocks.en: Memory and context management. Long-horizon agents manage growing interaction histories through memory hierarchies ( Packer et al., 2023 ) , abstraction of raw observations ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) , summaries of accumulated observations and interactions ( Kang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , or compression of sub-trajectories and selected history spans ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . These works mainly design how retained context is represented. AutoCompact uses a simple representation, a single working-state summary alongside the original task and recent turns, and focuses on when to compact and how to continue afterward.
blocks.zh: 记忆与上下文管理. 长视剂通过记忆分级(Packer等,2023年),抽象原始观测(郑等等,2024年),累积观测和相互作用总结(Kang等,2026年;Wu等,2025年;Liu等,2026年)来管理日益增长的相互作用历史,或压缩分谱和选定的历史跨度(Sun等,2025年;Ye等,2025年;Gao等,2026年). 这些作品主要设计如何体现保留上下文. AutoCompact使用一个简单的表示式,一个单一的工作状态摘要,与最初的任务和最近的转折相并列,并专注于何时紧凑,如何继续之后.

blocks.en: Learning context-management policies. Rubric- and guideline-based methods ( Li et al., 2026a ; Kang et al., 2026 ) steer compaction through instructions rather than training the agent’s own compaction behavior. Supervised methods learn from constructed trajectories ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) , for example by inserting context-management actions into completed trajectories ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , which keeps the original actions after each insertion, or by synthesizing them, as in concurrent work SWE-MeM ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , where a stronger model decides when to compress a span of steps and writes the summary but generates no task actions. RL methods ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Gao et al., 2026 ) optimize context management through rewards, in SWE-MeM with additional step-level masks for memory-management failures, but do not directly supervise the actions that follow compaction. Unlike these methods, AutoCompact corrects the agent’s own compaction decisions, summaries, and subsequent actions during data collection, executes the corrected outputs, and refines this behavior with outcome-based RL alone.
blocks.zh: 学习环境管理政策。 基于Rubric和准则的方法(Li等人,2026a; Kang等人,2026年)通过指示来引导收缩,而不是训练代理商自己的收缩行为. 监督方法学习了已构建的轨迹(刘等,2026;叶等,2025;高等,2026),例如将上下文管理动作插入已建成的轨迹(刘等,2026),每次插入后保留原有动作,或者如同时进行的工作SWE-MeM(高等,2026)那样,在其中,一个更强大的模型决定何时压缩跨度并写出摘要而未产生任务动作. RL方法(Wu等,2025;Sun等,2025;Li等,2026b;Gao等,2026)通过奖励优化上下文管理,在SWE-MeM中,为内存管理失误增加阶梯口罩,但不直接监督紧凑后的行为. 与这些方法不同,AutoCompact纠正了代理商自身在数据收集过程中的收缩决定,摘要,以及随后的行动,执行被纠正的输出,并仅用基于结果的RL来完善这种行为.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: AutoCompact trains coding agents to manage context as part of task execution. Judge-corrected trajectories provide supervision for compaction decisions, summary construction, and the actions that follow compaction, followed by outcome-based reinforcement learning that jointly optimizes coding and compaction. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-PolyBench Verified show improved task success across all evaluated inference budgets, and ignoring the compaction calls of the same trained model lowers pass rates, showing that the gains do not come from training alone. These findings highlight the value of training not only the construction of compacted states but also the agent’s behavior that follows from these states, which prior methods leave unsupervised.
blocks.zh: AutoCompact 列车编码代理作为任务执行的一部分来管理上下文. 判官修正的轨迹为收缩决定,即时构造,以及紧接后的行动提供监理,再进行基于结果的强化学习,共同优化编码和收缩. 在SWE-bench验证和SWE-Poly Bench验证的实验显示,在所有经评价的推论预算中,任务都取得了更好的成功,而忽略了同一训练有素模型的收缩呼声降低了通过率,表明收益并非仅来自培训。 这些调查结果凸显了培训的价值,不仅包括建设紧凑的州,而且还包括从这些州产生的代理人行为,而这些州以前的方法没有受到监督。

blocks.en: Limitations and future work. Due to resource constraints, RL training uses 32K-token sequences, shorter than the 256K context window used at evaluation. Nevertheless, the gains across all evaluated budgets in both the 256K and 16K settings indicate that this training setting suffices to learn useful proactive compaction. More broadly, AutoCompact is a form of model-harness co-design: the harness provides the compaction mechanism, while the model learns when to invoke it, what to preserve, and how to continue afterward. We study this co-design within a single scaffold. Widely used agent harnesses such as Codex and Claude Code currently compact the context automatically when it approaches the window limit, which is the length-triggered design discussed in Section 1 . Our 16K results suggest that combining such mechanisms with learned proactive compaction could further improve these systems, which we leave for future work.
blocks.zh: 限制和今后的工作。 由于资源限制,RL训练使用32K-token序列,比评价时使用的256K上下文窗口短. 尽管如此,在256K和16K两种环境中,所有经评价的预算都取得了收益,这表明这种培训环境足以学习有用的主动紧凑。 更广义地说,AutoCompact是模型-harness同构设计的一种:被牵引提供收缩机制,而模型则学习何时引用,保存什么,之后如何继续. 我们在一个脚手架内研究这个共同设计. 被广泛使用的代理设备,例如Codex和Claude Code,目前在接近窗口限制时会自动压缩上下文,这是第1节所讨论到的长度触发设计. 我们的16K成果表明,将这种机制同有学问的主动紧凑结合起来,可以进一步改进这些系统,我们留待今后的工作。

blocks.en: AI Use Statement
blocks.zh: AI 使用语句

blocks.en: In this work, we used generative AI tools for language editing and trajectory correction for training. We have reviewed all AI-assisted work. We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including text, claims, or artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们使用基因AI工具来进行语言编辑和轨迹校正来进行培训. 我们审查了所有AI协助的工作。 我们负责这项工作的最后内容,包括文本、权利主张或在基因AI的协助下生产的文物。
